title: Keeping Workplaces Safe Beyond the Heightened Safety Period
what_it_is: Keeping Workplaces Safe Beyond the Heightened Safety Period

sections.label: Workplace fatality rate improvement
sections.summary: The annualised fatality rate per 100,000 workers was about 0.8 in the first half of 2023, improving from 1.3 and about 1.6 earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: For the first half of 2023, the annualised fatality rate per 100,000 workers was about 0.8.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: This was a significant improvement from a rate of 1.3 in the second half of 2022 and about 1.6 in the first half of 2022.

sections.label: Fatalities after HSP exit
sections.summary: NTUC tracking found 13 workers died between June and August 2023, with the fatality rate rising from about 2.3 to 4.3 cases per month post-HSP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Based on the National Trades Union Congress’ (NTUC) internal tracking, within just three months of exiting the HSP, 13 workers tragically lost their lives between June and August 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Subject to MOM's confirmation of the statistics, this would mean that the fatality rate had gone up from about 2.3 cases per month during the HSP to an alarming 4.3 cases per month in the three months post-HSP.

sections.label: Logistics sector fatalities
sections.summary: The logistics and transportation sector had four fatalities in 2021, one in 2022 and five this year, and logistics companies need not appoint a WSH officer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Take, for example, our logistics and transportation sector, which accounted for four fatalities in 2021, one fatality in 2022 and five thus far this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Although classified as a high-risk sector, logistics companies are not required to appoint a WSH officer.

sections.label: Penalties and director disqualification
sections.summary: The questions ask whether MOM penalties accrue to a joint venture or its individual companies, and whether MOM can disqualify directors or proxies after debarment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Can MOM confirm if penalties imposed on workplace safety breaches accrue to a joint venture or to the individual companies that form that joint venture?

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Does MOM have a disqualification framework to disqualify a company director or any associate that he may use as a proxy from setting up a new company after one company had been debarred for safety breaches by MOM?

sections.label: WSH fatal injury rate target
sections.summary: The WSH aspiration is a fatal injury rate below 1.0 per 100,000 workers sustained by 2028, and the rate improved to 0.8 in the first half of 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our WSH aspiration remains to achieve a fatal injury rate of below 1.0 per 100,000 workers on a sustained basis by 2028.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: As the Member had pointed out, the fatal injury rate has improved to 0.8 per 100,000 workers in the first half of 2023.

sections.label: Manufacturing workplace injuries
sections.summary: Manufacturing was the top contributor of workplace fatal and major injuries in the first half of 2023, with 35% more injuries than the second half of 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Manufacturing was the top contributor of workplace fatal and major injuries in the first half of 2023, with 35% more injuries compared to the second half of 2022.

sections.label: Higher maximum fine for WSH breaches
sections.summary: The maximum fine for breaches of WSH Act Subsidiary Legislation that could cause death or serious bodily injury rises from $20,000 to $50,000 per breach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To further enhance deterrence, we will be increasing the maximum fine from $20,000 to $50,000 for breaches of WSH Act Subsidiary Legislation that could result in death or serious bodily injury, and this is per breach.

sections.label: Reviewing framework against errant companies
sections.summary: MOM is reviewing its framework to close the gap where errant companies or culpable directors set up a new entity to circumvent WSH penalties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: MOM is also reviewing our framework to close the gap where errant companies or culpable company directors can absolve their WSH responsibilities by setting up a new entity to circumvent penalties due to WSH breaches, such as debarment from hiring foreign workers.

sections.label: National WSH Campaign reporting theme
sections.summary: In May, MAST launched the National WSH Campaign with the theme "Reporting Saves Lives" to support workers taking ownership of safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Earlier in May, MAST launched the National WSH Campaign with the theme "Reporting Saves Lives" to support workers in taking ownership of their own and their co-workers' safety.

sections.label: Enhanced reporting channels including SnapSAFE
sections.summary: MOM has enhanced various channels to make reporting easy, including a dedicated SnapSAFE page on the MOM website.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: MOM has also enhanced various channels to make reporting easy, including a dedicated SnapSAFE page on MOM website.

sections.label: Public reporting and whistle-blower protection
sections.summary: The public can report unsafe work practices, and MOM will take action against errant practices and offer whistle-blower protection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Members of the public can also play an important role to be our "eyes on the ground" by reporting unsafe work practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We will take action against errant work practices, and we will also offer whistle-blower protection.
